steps.caption: The Payments page
steps.narration: Every payment from your clients lands on the Payments page. Here is how to read it.

steps.caption: The connected account
steps.narration: At the top is your payment account. This one is connected, with bank and card on.

steps.caption: Recent payments
steps.narration: Scroll down to Recent payments. Online payments and the ones you record share one list.

steps.caption: One payment
steps.narration: Each row starts with the amount, how it was paid, and what it was for.

steps.caption: The client
steps.narration: Under that is the client. Click the name to open their page.

steps.caption: The state
steps.narration: On the right is the state. Succeeded means the money came through.

steps.caption: Pending
steps.narration: Pending means a payment link was made and has not been paid yet.

steps.caption: Failed
steps.narration: Failed means the payment did not go through, so that client still owes you.

steps.caption: Refunded
steps.narration: A refunded payment stays in the list, and shows how much went back.

steps.caption: Recorded by hand
steps.narration: A check or cash you recorded yourself is here too, with your note.

steps.caption: Reverse
steps.narration: Those have a Reverse button, in case you typed one in wrong.

steps.caption: Processing
steps.narration: A bank payment says processing while the bank moves the money.

steps.caption: The bank payment clears
steps.narration: You do not have to do anything. When it clears, the state changes by itself.

steps.caption: Open Payments again
steps.narration: Open the Payments page again later,

steps.caption: Now succeeded
steps.narration: and the same payment now says succeeded.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find Payments in the left menu of your CRM.

youtube.title: How to read your Payments page | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See every client payment in one list in ConstructHUB CRM: the amount, how it was paid, who paid, and whether it succeeded, is pending, processing, failed or was refunded. The walkthrough uses a demo company with demonstration payments.
